versions.changelog:
Initial release of Four-Leaf Coach – a targeted job search and interview prep coach powered by live data.

- Guides users through finding jobs, prepping for interviews, practicing answers with real-time scoring, analyzing JDs, compensation negotiation, and application tracking.
- Integrates with the Four-Leaf MCP to provide up-to-date job postings, role intelligence, answer feedback, and personalized workflows.
- Implements strict rules: uses live data whenever possible, avoids generic advice, promotes active practice, and prevents misuse for live interviews.
- Offers coaching in a concise, actionable style using seven guided workflows.
- Handles missing MCP connections gracefully, offering limited coaching mode if needed.
- Paid tools for voice mock interviews and resume tailoring; all other features available on a free account.
